claims: The zodiac is a 360-degree belt.
The zodiac is divided into twelve 30-degree segments.
Each zodiac segment is named after a constellation.
The zodiac starts with the vernal equinox.

The 12 zodiac signs are Aries (Ram), Taurus (Bull), Gemini (Twins), Cancer (Crab), Leo (Lion), Virgo (Virgin), Libra (Balance), Scorpio (Scorpion), Sagittarius (Archer), Capricorn (Sea-Goat), Aquarius (Water-Bearer), Pisces (Fish).
Western Astrology is primarily based on the tropical zodiac.
The tropical zodiac is aligned with seasons/equinoxes.
Vedic Astrology is Jyotish.
Vedic Astrology uses the sidereal zodiac.
The sidereal zodiac is aligned with actual constellations.
Genethlialogy is the art of casting natal charts.
Natal charts are birth charts.
In Western astrology, planets include the Sun and Moon (the "lights"), Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto.
The 12 signs are divided into four elements.
Fire signs are Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.
Earth signs are Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.
Air signs are Gemini, Libra, Aquarius.
Water signs are Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.
Aspects are the geometric relationships or angles between planets in a horoscope.
Conjunction, opposition, and square are aspects in astrology.
Modern scientific inquiry has found no evidence to support the premises of astrology.
Astrology is regarded as a pseudoscience.
Astrology has failed controlled studies.
Astrology is considered a belief system rather than a validated scientific method.
